6205.title: DIAG-001: Align rendered artifact policy and current diagram ignore/drift contract
6205.decision: SVG sibling outputs under docs/02-architecture/diagrams/** are the PR-blocking render baselines required by drift checks and architecture guards. PNG outputs remain a curated compatibility surface checked through docs/02-architecture/diagrams/manifests/png-compatibility.txt in nightly gates.

6206.title: DIAG-002: Enforce local Mermaid CLI version parity with CI
6206.decision: MMDC_REQUIRED_VERSION=10.6.1 is enforced in mmdc_wrapper.sh and render.sh with MMDC_ALLOW_VERSION_DRIFT=1 override for diagnostics.

6207.title: DIAG-003: Make diagram renderer writes atomic for SVG and PNG outputs
6207.decision: render.sh writes SVG/PNG to per-file temp directories and replaces final outputs atomically.

6208.title: DIAG-004: Add repo-wide embedded Mermaid validation for active documentation
6208.decision: validate_mermaid_syntax.sh --include-embedded validates fenced Mermaid blocks in active docs; docs.yml runs it in CI.

6209.title: DIAG-005: Add JSON output to standalone visual smoke regression check
6209.decision: check_diagram_visual_smoke.py emits diagram-visual-smoke-report-v1 via --json-out; docs.yml and nightly upload the report.

6210.title: DIAG-006: Document Windows and PowerShell diagram workflow
6210.decision: docs/02-architecture/diagrams/README.md documents Git Bash/WSL requirement plus PowerShell launch examples for validation, render, and Python checks.

6211.title: DIAG-007: Decide and document MkDocs publication/deploy target
6211.decision: MkDocs remains validation-only; docs/site/** is local generated output and there is no GitHub Pages deploy job.
